stemMarkdown: Find the highest power of $3$ that divides $50!$.
solutionMarkdown: By Legendre's formula, add the floors of $50$ divided by successive powers of $3$: \left\lfloor \dfrac{50}{3} \right\rfloor = 16 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{50}{9} \right\rfloor = 5 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{50}{27} \right\rfloor = 1. The total is $22$.
